## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Name the milestone and affected acceptance gates. Link or identify any implementation decision that changes a specification or contract.

## Evidence

Record actual commands/interactions and results, source/fixture identity, OS/toolchain, and relevant device/display configuration. Include a short synthetic native demonstration when appropriate. Mark failures and not-run checks explicitly; a screenshot or unit test cannot establish native focus/Space/display behavior.

## Boundaries and limitations

Describe new collection/retention/transmission/deletion, consent/manual/offline behavior, reward/provenance/schema migrations, dependencies/assets and reuse rights, and unsupported configurations. Explain any remaining gate that prevents milestone acceptance.

## Review

- [ ] Change stays within its named milestone or records a justified scope decision.
- [ ] Scoring and frozen contracts match the authoritative policy; meaningful changed boundaries have relevant verification.
- [ ] Fixtures, recordings, logs, and exports contain synthetic or separately consented/redacted data; no credentials or private project material are included.
- [ ] Third-party notices cover imported code/assets and redistribution rights.
- [ ] Status and limitations reflect actual evidence; targets, future behavior, and publication are not described as passed or available.
